tool: sandbox request folder, query as nsdn_reader
query: SELECT t.temporal_type_desc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.triggers tr WHERE tr.parent_id=OBJECT_ID('Sales.Orders')) AS triggers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.check_constraints cc WHERE cc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('Sales.Orders')) AS checks, (SELECT CAST(ep.value AS nvarchar(4000)) FROM sys.extended_properties ep WHERE ep.class=1 AND ep.major_id=OBJECT_ID('Sales.Orders') AND ep.minor_id=0 AND ep.name='Description') AS table_description FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.object_id=OBJECT_ID('Sales.Orders')
